paragraphs: CredibleMind partners with health plans, health systems, employers, and communities to break down the barriers of stigma, navigation, and cost that keep people from mental health care. Its platform blends evidence-based self-care, early intervention, and screening-based navigation into one integrated experience.

People start with validated assessments, and each customer configures referral rules and custom questions that triage higher-acuity needs to in-network care. The catalog runs to over a dozen assessments and more than 100 content topic centers. Behind those sit more than 10,000 evidence-rated resources that the company describes as grounded in science. The experience is designed for accessibility and available in 38 languages. APIs and EHR integrations tie the platform into clinical workflows.

The company says it works with more than 150 partners and supports over 40 million lives. Its stated partners include public sector agencies and community organizations. Deryk Van Brunt is a co-founder of the company and serves as its chief executive. Marcos Athanasoulis, also a co-founder, serves as chief technology officer.

quote.text: Our team of designers, data scientists, behaviorists, content creators, and clinicians share a passion for lighting the path to better mental health, for everyone.
